1.explanation: The bug relates specifically to how reStructuredText (reST) elements are parsed and highlighted. File components/prism-rest.js is responsible for defining the tokenization and highlighting rules for the reST language in Prism.js. As the problem is that the syntax rules for links and inline code are not correctly separating these constructs when they appear on the same line, the fix will need to be made to the grammar definitions in this file. No other files are directly relevant, as the problem is in reST highlighting, not core Prism logic or plugins.
1.bug_scenario: The bug occurs when highlighting reStructuredText (reST) code snippets. When a link and verbatim (inline code) are on the same line, Prism.js fails to detect and highlight the link and the verbatim element separately. Instead, the entire line is incorrectly rendered as italic. When split into multiple lines, highlighting works correctly, distinguishing links and inline code as expected. The bug is visible in the first image where everything is in italics, and correct behavior is shown in the second image with different colors for link and code elements.

No plugin files or general files (like prism.js) directly handle language specifics, so only the reST highlighter file is directly relevant for this bug.
2.bug_scenario: In the bug report, reStructuredText (reST) syntax is not properly highlighted when a link and a verbatim element appear on the same line: the entire text is rendered in italics instead of correctly identifying the inline code (``ALTER_ROLE``) and the hyperlink (`ALTER ROLE <url>`_).
